selected.selection_rule: Among converged integer c_IP=1..30 cases, maximize absolute Si64 error subject to error <= CP2K target. Break ties by smaller c_IP.

method_note: Only Si64 is calibrated to the CP2K cpFIT3 ADMM-versus-no-ADMM absolute energy difference. Kylin-PBC errors use its own same-settings FFTDF reference, never a cross-program total-energy subtraction. The selected c_IP is then fixed across system sizes; accuracy matching at every size has not been established. CP2K total time includes its PBE calculation and HSE06 restart. Comparisons to historical Kylin-PBC also involve a different implementation, so changes in speed cannot all be attributed to c_IP.
